cards.input: Activities, events, participants, messages, data, and flow conditions.
cards.operation: Encode process or collaboration behavior using BPMN elements and their execution semantics.
cards.output: Conformant process, collaboration, or choreography model.
cards.scope_conditions: Business processes and inter-participant behavior representable by BPMN.
cards.failure_conditions: A partial implementation may not claim conformance; model behavior can remain underspecified when optional semantics are omitted.
cards.predicted_effect: Absent; specification defines representation and execution, not an outcome advantage.
cards.measurement: Conformance against the applicable BPMN conformance class.
cards.implementation_test: Encode a process with activities, gateways, events, participants, and data; validate structural and execution conformance.
cards.decision_rights: Participants, lanes, performers, and resource assignments can be represented.
cards.implementation_cost: Modeling and conformant-tooling effort; magnitude absent.
cards.limitations: Independent primary application source absent; therefore coverage-insufficient for material mapping.

cards.input: Artifacts/entities, activities, agents, and their relationships.
cards.operation: Assert interoperable provenance relations including use, generation, derivation, attribution, revision, invalidation, roles, plans, and qualified influence; assign persistent identifiers and metadata.
cards.output: A provenance graph and identifiable metadata records.
cards.scope_conditions: Digital or conceptual resources whose history can be represented as PROV assertions and FAIR metadata.
cards.failure_conditions: Incomplete assertions cannot establish an unrecorded relation; FAIR does not itself guarantee quality or reproducibility.
cards.predicted_effect: Improved findability and machine-interpretable provenance; no universal performance effect claimed.
cards.measurement: Presence of required identifier, metadata, and provenance relations; graph query coverage.
cards.implementation_test: Given an output, retrieve its generating activity, used entities, responsible agent, derivation/revision chain, and identifier-linked metadata.
cards.decision_rights: Responsibility, attribution, association, delegation, plan, and role can be recorded; governance authority is not assigned.
cards.uncertainty_handling: No native confidence calculus; qualified relations can carry additional attributes.
cards.provenance: PV01 sections 2-3; PV02 Box 2 F1-F4, R1-R1.3.
cards.implementation_cost: Identifier, metadata, ontology mapping, storage, and capture effort; magnitude absent.
cards.limitations: Representation does not ensure truthful or complete capture.

inference: query-based implementation test and cost categories

cards.input: Analytic question, alternative hypotheses, evidence, assumptions, and observable indicators.
cards.operation: Externalize alternatives; compare evidence for inconsistency/disconfirmation; define observable indicators and periodically update them.
cards.output: Comparative analytic judgment and monitored indicator list.
cards.scope_conditions: Diagnostic or warning problems with plausible alternatives and observable signs.
cards.failure_conditions: Weak source evaluation, omitted alternatives, ambiguous indicators, or failure to update can mislead.
cards.predicted_effect: More rigorous, explicit comparison and earlier detection of change; no quantified effect.
cards.measurement: Whether alternatives, evidence consistency, and indicator changes are recorded and reviewed.
cards.implementation_test: Construct competing hypotheses and an evidence matrix; identify disconfirming evidence; specify indicators and repeat review after new observations.
cards.decision_rights: Analyst or team constructs and updates the analysis; policy authority is outside the method.
cards.uncertainty_handling: Maintains alternatives and challenges assumptions; no calibrated probability rule verified.
cards.verification: Systematic source review and periodic indicator review.
cards.implementation_cost: Hours to days for indicator construction; advanced techniques may require substantial analyst time and organizational resources.
cards.limitations: coverage-insufficient because the alleged original-method lead was invalid and no independent original source was verified.
